summary:
Iteration 73 - Live retest of items that were CODE-ONLY / NOT-EXECUTED in iter_72. Covered R1 (old sketch load, auto-straighten exception on open), R2 (photo exception, bg + image-element variants), R8 (point-mode + openings - previous bug) and R9 (phone 390x844: numpad auto-collapses when Mehr opens). All four LIVE-PASS. R3, R4, R5, R6, R7 steps 4-8 NOT-EXECUTED due to token budget (focused budget on highest-priority items R1/R2/R7/R9 per instructions; R7 steps 1-6 already live-passed in iter_72 so R7 remaining 4-8 skipped). Zero PAGEERROR across session.

LIVE-PASS (4 items):
- R1 OLD SKETCH LOAD: Drew skewed quad (220,250)(520,260)(530,490)(210,470), measured 4/3/4/3 with auto-straighten=0, opened Mehr, toggled area-angles-toggle ON, pressed area-angle-90-0 (room determined but drawing stays skewed since auto OFF), saved via sketch-save-button. Found new id in aufmassprofi_sketches. Set aufmassprofi_auto_straighten='1' and location.assign('/sketches/draw?projectId=p1&sketchId=<id>'). LABEL POSITIONS AT LOAD = AFTER 4s (diff=0 across all 4 labels). Then clicked line-0 label, changed to 4,5 and committed -> drawing re-snapped (diff=45 on labels, side 2 auto-propagated). Repeated for line-2 -> diff=38 to 4,5 x 3 rectangle 13,50 m2. Spec confirmed: drawing does NOT snap on open even with auto=ON because `previous === undefined` branch at draw.tsx:800 remembers the loaded key without snapping; on first user measurement change the per-element key changes and auto-straighten fires. /tmp/R1_after_load.png, /tmp/R1_after_changes.png.
- R2 PHOTO EXCEPTION:
  Variant (a) BACKGROUND IMAGE: Saved new skewed sketch (4/3/4/3, 90 angle set), then via page.evaluate set `sketch_bg_<id>` to the provided 1x1 PNG data URI and aufmassprofi_auto_straighten='1', reopened with ?sketchId=<id>. Drawing loaded still skewed. Measurement change attempt did not re-snap the drawing (label diff=0). Manual area-straighten button is present and clickable. /tmp/R2a_after_change.png.
  Variant (b) IMAGE ELEMENT: removed sketch_bg_<id>, patched sketch_meta_<id>.elements to append {id:'img-test-1',type:'image',data:{uri,x:50,y:50,width:40,height:40}}. Reopened, image element rendered top-left of canvas. Changed line-1 to 3,5 and committed (UI confirmed label change to 3,5m, area recomputed to 12,97 m2 in overview). Label diff load-vs-after = 6 px (only the one changed label shifted slightly). Drawing did NOT snap. Confirms `onPhoto = !!backgroundImage || elements.some(el=>el.type==='image')` short-circuit at draw.tsx:793-800 is active in both variants. /tmp/R2b_after_change.png.
- R8 POINT-MODE + OPENINGS (previous B2 LIVE-FAIL, now FIXED): Drew clean rectangle (200,250)(520,250)(520,490)(200,490), tool-edit, clicked point-move-only-toggle (background color changed from rgb(245,245,245) to rgb(25,118,210) = active blue). Long-press (mouse.down -> 1100ms -> up) on right-line midpoint (520,370) -> OpeningInsertMenu DID appear (opening-insert-door and opening-insert-window both present with 'An Linie 2 einfugen' header). Clicked opening-insert-window -> window inserted (opening-marker-* present with 'F 1,00'), AND point-move-only-toggle auto-switched OFF (background back to rgb(245,245,245)). This was the HIGH-priority bug from iter_72; the fix is now LIVE verified. /tmp/R8_longpress.png, /tmp/R8_after_insert.png.
- R9 PHONE 390x844 MEHR AUTO-COLLAPSES NUMPAD: Drew skewed quad on phone viewport, measured 4/3/4/3, re-opened measure panel on line 0. line-measure-scroll height = 118 px BEFORE Mehr (numpad docked). Tapped panel-options-toggle -> line-measure-scroll height jumped to 594 px (numpad collapsed, Mehr content fills the panel, screenshot shows all area-options: Laser, Nachste Linie, Ton, Linien-Nummern, Tutorial, Wandhohe, Flache 12,00 m2 AN, 'Noch 1 Angabe fehlt' copy). Tapped area-angles-toggle + area-angle-90-0 -> area-status = 'Raum eindeutig bestimmt - Flache 12,00 m2. Alle ubrigen Winkel und Diagonalen sind berechnet.' Drawing snapped to 4x3 rectangle, stayed inside canvas. Tapping area-angle-1 field re-opened the numpad (scroll height 343 px, numpad visible again). Closing Mehr: scroll height back to 118 px, numpad fully back. Persistence key `aufmassprofi_panel_options_open` is set in localStorage (so Mehr state persists across reloads; reload-with-Mehr-open also starts numpad collapsed). /tmp/R9_before_mehr.png, /tmp/R9_after_mehr.png, /tmp/R9_after_90.png.

NOT-EXECUTED (5 items, budget):
- R3 6-corner L-room: complete flow (draw+measure 6 sides+enter angles) estimated 60-80 UI actions; iter_72 could only partially drive it (one 1,5 m vertical side mid-point was hard to click). Would benefit from a 'click-nearest-segment' helper. Code review of /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/AreaOptionsSection.tsx:147 confirms missing-count copy 'Noch N Angaben fehlen' and determined copy; polygonArea.ts contains the solver.
- R4 8-corner U/notch: same reason as R3, even more steps.
- R5 Openings after snap: requires drawing+measuring+long-press+angle sequence. Earlier iter_72 confirmed opening-marker exists; combined with R8 PASS and R1 snap PASS the integration is reasonable but not driven end-to-end in this run.
- R6 Legacy rightAngles: requires patching sketch_meta_<id>.polygonAreaOptions[id]={rightAngles:true} on a saved sketch then reopening. Code review (AreaOptionsSection.tsx:193) already confirmed `area-right-angles-toggle` renders only when rightAngles===true, matching the spec. Not driven live.
- R7 practice steps 4-8: iter_72 drove 1-6 live; 7-8 (long-press for opening + drag with measure-panel-open) still not executed end-to-end. Was lower priority than R1/R2/R9 per instructions, and the two underlying mechanics (long-press + opening-drag) are already live-verified by R8 and by iter_71 O1.

Zero PAGEERROR and zero console[error] across the session.

action_items: (LOW) Still-not-executed scenarios R3 (6-corner L), R4 (8-corner U), R5 (openings after snap), R6 (legacy rightAngles seed), R7 steps 7-8 (long-press + drag inside practice). Each is covered by code review and by partial live verification of the underlying primitives (long-press works R8/iter_71; snap works R1; area-right-angles-toggle gating confirmed in iter_72). They should be driven live by the main agent with a scripted 'click-nearest-segment-midpoint' helper that uses line endpoint coordinates (available in sketch_meta_<id>.elements[0].data.points) rather than hard-coded pixel guesses - this will unblock all four remaining scenarios in a single short run.

(INFO) R9 persistence key is `aufmassprofi_panel_options_open` (not `aufmassprofi_sketch_mehr_open`) - please document this in iter71_recipe.md so next agents can seed Mehr state directly instead of driving the toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: Photo exception path draw.tsx:793 `const onPhoto = !!backgroundImage || elements.some(el => el.type === 'image');` combined with the `|| onPhoto` guard at :800 is verified LIVE in both variants (background image via sketch_bg_<id>, and explicit image element in metadata.elements). No code change required.

Initial-load no-snap path draw.tsx:800 `if (previous === undefined || previous === key || !autoStraighten || onPhoto) return el;` -> on the very first effect run per element the key is undefined so no snap fires -> R1 PASS. The per-element keyMap (autoStraightenKeysRef) correctly records the loaded shape so subsequent user edits trigger the snap.

R8 fix in gesture arbiter resolves the iter_72 HIGH-priority bug: long-press on a LINE midpoint now reaches the opening-insert dispatcher even when pointMoveOnly is true, and the insert-handler calls setPointMoveOnly(false) so the new marker is draggable immediately. Verified by color change rgb(25,118,210) -> rgb(245,245,245) on point-move-only-toggle after insert.

R9 MeasurePanel on phone: the previously reported cramped Mehr area is FIXED. When panel-options-toggle is on, the panel body switches from numpad (~380 px) to the options list (~594 px on 390x844) and vice versa. Persistence is handled by `aufmassprofi_panel_options_open`.

success_rate.frontend: LIVE-PASS 4 (R1, R2, R8, R9) / NOT-EXECUTED 5 (R3, R4, R5, R6, R7 steps 7-8). 0 PAGEERROR, 0 console[error].

seed_data_creation: Transient localStorage only (aufmassprofi_settings, aufmassprofi_customers [TEST_Max Muster/cust1], aufmassprofi_projects [TEST_Projekt/p1], aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked, tour flags, app_language='de'). Two throwaway sketches were created in aufmassprofi_sketches during R1/R2 (titled 'Neue Skizze'); they live in the preview localStorage only and will be cleared on next browser session reset. No user data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Highest-value items (R1, R2, R8, R9) are LIVE-PASS. Previous iter_72 HIGH-priority bug (point-move-only long-press-on-line) is FIXED. Only R3/R4/R5/R6/R7-step7-8 remain CODE-ONLY; all of them exercise mechanics already live-verified elsewhere. If driving them, use sketch_meta_<id>.elements[0].data.points to compute exact line midpoints instead of the tester's pixel heuristic - that was the only blocker for the 6-corner and 8-corner flows in iter_72.
